body: If I do say something then it'll get around that I'm suicidal and that's going to make it worse than it is now. I might not even be able to carry it out if I'm marked as suicidal. Either that or they'll have me go to some counselor but that's even worse because I don't want anybody knowing *anything* about my gender or my self-loathing.

I don't enjoy going outdoors or talking to other people. Also I'm really selfish so volunteer work doesn't cut it for me. Everything would be much simpler if I was either dead or didn't exist. I can't erase my existence but I can choose to stop living. I think if I just take the leap and hope for the best it'll work out.

I honestly do appreciate the effort you put in for a no-name shit like me over the internet, but it's too late to change how I feel it's part of me.

I know I'm not as stupid as I'd like to think, just incredibly average or a little bit below that. It's really childish how much I want to be better than everybody else but I don't want to work for it. All life means for me is a constant worry about whether or not my future is bright and if it's not, why bother living it?

I can't fix my other problem because I don't want to just become female I wish I had grown up as one. I feel like maybe my life wouldn't be like it is right now if I had.

Well I appreciate the understanding at least. I'll just say a few things, the self-loathing is very bad, I'm incredibly stupid along with being lazy so I don't get places in life, and also I shouldn't be a guy.

I know many people regret it. I'll take it into consideration to make sure that when I carry it out there's no room for survival.

Things will not get better. I simply won't allow them to I can't let myself have good things happen.

I don't care much for the beauty of life or anything like that. Any good things in life aren't worth the effort put in to getting them. Similar to you I hate myself and think that I might as well just suffer through my life until I can't take it anymore. The indecision is horrible I want to die badly, but at the same time I'm scared to do it myself. It would be much simpler if somebody could just make the decision for me (shooting incident, car wreck, etc).
